summary: Accepted after independently recomputing the sealed proposal and candidate identities, reconciling all 44 date-only claim/hint operations to the seven frozen audit findings, and checking their cited Chinese units and supplied chronology. The candidate narrows Jin accession to AD 936; removes unsupported jade-pillow, generic empress-dowager, and historian-commentary chronology and hints; makes the three-rebellions campaign AD 948–949; corrects every Northern Suburb/Yindi context and dependent hint to AD 950; and confines Jin Tianfu contexts to AD 936–942. No unsupported candidate chronology remains within the frozen review scope.

sourceEvidence: s0005: 「嘗在晉祖麾下，遂留為親從，及踐阼，用為控鶴小校。」
reviewedChanges.reason: 踐阼 denotes the accession event, so AD 936 is supported; the whole Later Jin reign through AD 942 is not the date of this appointment.

sourceEvidence: s0034: 「遣家僮及商人李進賣於淮南」.
s0036: the later allegation dates the Khitan ruler’s entry into Bian, not the jade-pillow sale itself.
reviewedChanges.reason: The sale and participants are source-attested but undated. Removing the derived post-947 bounds and both hints preserves the episode without treating a later allegation as their activity date.

sourceEvidence: s0159: 「周祖征三叛，韜從白文珂攻河中」.
Frozen audit chronology: the command to the Hezhong front began in August AD 948 and Hezhong was recovered in AD 949.
reviewedChanges.reason: The campaign spans AD 948–949; a point at AD 949 improperly erases its documented start.

These are Yindi-context kinship references and do not establish a personal AD 947–951 activity interval for the generic empress-dowager record. The candidate correctly retains an undated attestation and removes the hint.

sourceEvidence: s0083: 「乾祐三年冬十一月十三日」 anchors the chapter’s Qianyou 3 context.
s0272/s0274: 「北郊兵敗」 followed by Ye’s flight and death.
s0173: 「北郊兵敗，晉卿乃自殺於家。」
s0181/s0183: the emperor at the Northern Suburb and 「遲明，帝遇禍」.
s0191: 「北郊兵敗」 followed by capture/execution.
s0204: 「及北郊之敗」 and Yuming’s murder/suicide.
reviewedChanges.reason: The linked defeat, Yindi killing, Ye crossing, flight, suicide, arrest, and death events are Qianyou 3 (AD 950), whereas AD 951 is Zhou Taizu’s accession year. Each corrected claim and derived hint now uses AD 950 while retaining separately sourced earlier bounds where present.

sourceEvidence: s0207: 「晉天福中，高祖為侍衛親軍都指揮使」.
reviewedChanges.reason: This is a Gaozu/Later Jin Tianfu context, whose verified inclusive era bounds are AD 936–942; the former AD 944 endpoint is unsupported.

This is an anonymous historiographical-commentary label, not a named person’s activity or composition date. The candidate preserves the source attestation as undated and removes the derived post-951 hint.
